shareholdingPatternNotes: 1. As Mr. Abhay Soi, Chairman and Managing Director of the Company is also promoter of the Company, therefore, his shareholding in the Company has been classified under the Promoter Category. To prevent duplication, his shareholding has not been included under non institutions category i.e. Directors and their relatives (excluding independent directors and nominee directors) and Key Managerial Personnel;  2. Under point B(4)(i), shareholding of Non-Resident Indians represents shares held in repatriable and non-repatriable basis;  3. The shareholding of Promoters and Public are consolidated on the basis of PAN;  4. The categorization of shareholders in the Shareholding Pattern is disclosed based on the categorization mentioned in the BENPOS received from MUFG Intime India Private Limited (formerly known as Link Intime India Private Limited), Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent of the Company.  5. The name of Radiant Life Care Foundation was changed to Radiant Life Care Hospital Foundation (RLCHF) with effect from April 21, 2026, pursuant to the issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation pursuant to change of name.  RLCHF had submitted an application seeking reclassification from the 'Promoter Group' to the 'Public' category on May 12, 2026, which was approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 21, 2026. Pursuant thereto, the Company submitted applications to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on May 24, 2026, seeking their respective no-objection letters for the proposed reclassification. The Company received the requisite no-objection letters from the stock exchanges on July 1, 2026 and consequently, RLCHF stood reclassified under the 'Public' category.   Since the said reclassification took effect subsequent to the close of the quarter ended June 30, 2026, RLCHF has been disclosed as forming part of the Promoter Group of the Company in the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
